question: Cataract surgery swaps the cloudy lens. Can the new one do more?
answer: Removing the cloudy lens clears the fog, but the eye's old focusing faults stay. A premium lens carries its own prescription, so the same implant can also correct short-sight, long-sight, astigmatism and ageing near vision.
move: A new lens can be both clear and a prescription.

web.label: Interactive card with five eye-problem options to select: short-sighted, long-sighted, astigmatism, ageing near vision, and operate on both eyes. The reader picks the patient's problems, then operates to see whether one clear, corrected implant fixes them.

source: Geopop, “Intervento alla cataratta: vi spieghiamo cosa succede con delle animazioni 3D” (YouTube, 2026)
